points.name: Akayu Onsen
points.season: Closed November to April. Usually reopens just before Golden Week.
points.access: About 2 hours' hike from the end of the Akayu forest road beyond Naeba.
points.note: Three river-side outdoor pools at a lamp-lit hut. You can dig your own pool on the riverbank upstream. No phone signal in the valley.
